entries.body:
Summary (round 4 of 11 released; rounds 05-11 still to release via {"action":"advance"}):

Log format: "2026-09-14T11:02:24Z WARN  inventory-svc db pool exhausted wait_ms=1403 in_use=10/10" (ISO time, LEVEL, service, msg, k=v).
- "slow query ms=NNN table=..." WARNs are noise; filter them out.
- Other observed message types:
  - "cache miss storm key_prefix=X: misses_per_s=N"
  - "ERROR ... upstream returned 429 upstream=tax-provider retry_after..."
- The log format may change in later rounds.

Changes (round-01/changes.md):
- :3 CHG-107 PROPOSED: HPA max replicas for search tier. Not applied.
- :4 CHG-113 APPLIED: build 8.23.7 to search-api, sets cache.ttl_s=-1. Invalid value; possible BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT or CACHE_STAMPEDE source.
- :5 CHG-114 APPLIED: build 8.23.7 to auth-svc, no config change.
- Round 4 had no changes.md (the script checks for one each round).

Threads:
- Thread A: DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED; inventory-svc and notify-worker; ongoing (round-02/board.md:3).
  - round-01 inventory-svc.log:5,9,28,30,45,52
  - round-02 inventory-svc.log:3-78; round-02 notify-worker.log:6-57
  - round-03 inventory-svc.log:12-76; round-03 notify-worker.log:4-71
  - round-04 inventory-svc.log:3-84 (3,19,21,23,34,35,59,61,74,84)
  - round-04 notify-worker.log:11-73
- Thread D: CACHE_STAMPEDE; auth-svc; ongoing (round-03/board.md:3).
  - round-03 auth-svc.log:1,15,16,18,24,43
  - round-04 auth-svc.log storms at 1,2,18,23,42,52,53,55,63,65,71,72,74
  - Note: auth-svc got no config change, but search-api's ttl=-1 (CHG-113) may be the real source if the board later relinks it. search-api had no WARNs in rounds 1-2; rounds 3-4 search-api showed none either.
- Thread B: opened round-04/board.md:3, "errors in auth-svc", suspected MEMORY_LEAK, ongoing.
  - No memory or restart lines seen in the logs.
  - Logs instead show 429s from tax-provider: round-04 auth-svc.log:12,16,17,34,36,41,60,73,82,91,93,100 and round-04 shipping-svc.log:5,21,28,29,33,36,41,54,58,61.
  - Likely the cause will be revised to UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMIT, with services auth-svc and shipping-svc. Watch for the board update.

Follow-ups:
- VENDOR_TICKET OPEN (round-04/board.md:4).

Notes are in /task/workspace/notes.md (appended through R3; R4 not yet appended).

Next steps:
1. Append the R4 notes.
2. Advance and inspect each round. The step-11 script prints board.md, changes.md if present, and non-noise WARN/ERROR lines with line numbers.
3. Track per round:
   - thread cause/status updates (latest wins) and superseded causes
   - follow-up open/close events
   - new change records
4. Submit final only after round 11. Include CHG-113 (round-01/changes.md:4) if a cause traces back to it.

[step 12] execute
